policy: Raw, curated, or live-resolved OpenPage avatar records must carry explicit catalog identity, a unique catalog contract address, or an OpenPage ID covered by data/openpage_catalog_bindings.json. Animation-only GLBs are preserved as evidence but are not avatar-model candidates. Live requests create partial discovery candidates only.

examples.note: The workflow resolves each ID against /m/mml/{id}, preserves source evidence, and discovers referenced VRM or model GLB URLs.
